rules.description: The user asks to derive or compute a mathematical or numeric result from supplied information, including arithmetic operations, equations, formulas, percentages, unit conversions, age from a birth year or date, elapsed durations or date/time differences, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, statistics, probability, calculus, or other mathematical computation. The request may be phrased as an ordinary factual question and does not need to contain explicit arithmetic symbols or words such as calculate or compute.
The user asks how to recover, reset, change, or regain access to a forgotten password.

then.canonical_answer: The user must contact their administrator to reset the password.

rules.description: When no reliable answer can be produced, suggest contacting a human by email.
